description: Compare available agent, human, vendor and provider capacity with a defined demand horizon.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Compare available agent, human, vendor and provider capacity with a defined demand horizon.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: demand units and horizon; available capacity and units; observed throughput, backlog and quota limits; service expectations and budget

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: demand/capacity table; bottleneck and uncertainty register; base, constrained and expansion scenarios; decision and monitoring plan

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Establish project/commitment scope, comparable deliverable units, horizon and approved priorities. Use actual role/skills, shared agent concurrency/provider quotas, human availability and observed throughput; do not sum incompatible units or reuse the same shared pool twice.

Calculate supply before fitting demand. For human capacity show gross period hours minus booked absence/on-call/overhead and ramp factors; for agent capacity show observed accepted throughput, quota/concurrency and availability. Mark proposed factors and never substitute upstream benchmark percentages for measured/company-approved inputs.

List each commitment with accountable owner, required discipline/capability, estimate/uncertainty, priority, dependencies and externally-promised status. Verify whether risk adjustment or reserve is already included; apply each at most once.

Allocate whole commitments in approved priority/dependency order against independently established effective capacity. Publish the exact cut line, unscheduled commitments, remaining capacity and skill bottlenecks. Split work only if the owner permits a divisible deliverable; an aggregate shortfall is not permission to partly execute an atomic commitment.
Escalate an externally promised commitment that does not fit with evidence, owner and decision deadline. Do not silently assume extra workers, quota, new hires or acceptable late delivery.

For below-the-line work compare defer, reallocation, contracted or added capacity by time to relief, verified recurring/one-time cost, ramp, reversibility and knowledge continuity. Distinguish measured gains from projections and include the no-change alternative.

Return current allocation table, cut-line report and scenario recommendation with sources, uncertainty, owner approvals, monitoring and replan triggers. Eric retains engineering execution priority; Sara supplies operating capacity advice.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
